claim_text: A preregistered retention policy (I1 MUT_REDUNDANT) beat the inherited MRU eviction policy by +2.78pp CFR over 30 paired lineages, above the preregistered 1.9pp MDE, the only contrast of five to survive Holm correction.
source_quote: PRIMARY, vs the inherited policy: SELECTIVE_MEMORY_EFFECT (established, bounded) A preregistered retention policy changed future CFR by +2.78 pp above a 1.9 pp MDE with Holm-corrected p = 0.0040.
verdict_metric: +2.78 pp, p = 0.0008, Holm 0.0040, n = 30 paired lineages, 90% CI [+1.59, +3.97] pp, MDE 1.9 pp
gate: Preregistration frozen and hashed before first experimental organism-evaluation (PREREG_GEN1_2026-09-01.txt, blob 570835d4); analysis script committed at a762ffffd before any summary file was opened; two-sided paired sign-flip permutation, 20,000 draws, Holm-Bonferroni across five preregistered contrasts; unit of inference is the lineage per the Gen-1A ruling.
qualifications: +2.78 pp is one extra task in forty-two (I1 solves 13.2 of 42 vs I0 12.0); measured on one consumer, one substrate, one 42-task battery with a shared 64-point domain, at one budget; no claim of generality; the treatment is policy PLUS its induced trajectory, nothing isolates library content; no capability, cognition or intelligence claim.
substrate: D-5 frozen search core (agent_d5_blind), 4 eviction-policy arms x 30 paired lineages x 42 non-control tasks x 30,000 evaluations, cap 64
mechanism_hint: selective retention: evict residents redundant both behaviourally (identical fingerprint) and mutationally (offspring-sketch Jaccard >= 0.50)
consumer_hint: D-5 searcher (frozen consumer)

claim_text: Selective retention did NOT beat arbitrary (random-eviction) memory after correction: I1-I3 is +1.51pp with Holm 0.0912, below the MDE, so the evidence supports only that the inherited MRU rule is the worst of the four policies tested.
source_quote: PRIMARY, vs arbitrary memory: NOT ESTABLISHED I1 - I3 is +1.51 pp, Holm 0.0912, below MDE. The evidence does not support "principled selection beats arbitrary eviction". It supports "the inherited MRU rule is the worst of the four tested."
gate: The design set the arbitrary-memory bar precisely to separate 'better than history' from 'better than arbitrary'; Holm-Bonferroni across five preregistered contrasts.
qualifications: Suggestive and underpowered; the packet recommends a powered rerun of I1 vs I3 alone at n=60 as the single most valuable cheap experiment; until settled the honest summary of Gen-1 is 'MRU is the worst rule we have tried.'
substrate: D-5 frozen search core, arms I1 (MUT_REDUNDANT) vs I3 (RANDOM eviction), 30 paired lineages x 42 tasks x 30,000 evaluations
mechanism_hint: selection vs churn: whether any effect is about principled selection rather than eviction churn
related_hints: recommended powered I1-vs-I3 rerun at n=60

claim_text: Same phenotype does not imply same mutational affordances: 77% of the apparent 58% behavioural redundancy in the Gen-1A corpus does not survive the preregistered mutational-redundancy test, because behavioural duplicates are typically near-maximally different programs opening onto substantially different futures.
source_quote: SO: 77% of the apparent redundancy does NOT survive the stronger test. Behavioural duplicates are typically near-maximally different PROGRAMS that happen to compute the same function, and they open onto substantially different futures. Evicting one destroys roughly two thirds of a distinct mutation neighbourhood. SAME PHENOTYPE != SAME MUTATIONAL AFFORDANCES.  Confirmed.
verdict_metric: MR median 0.333 over 6,505 same-fingerprint pairs; at preregistered tau 0.50 only 23.0% of behavioural duplicates are also evolutionarily redundant; median genotype edit distance between duplicates 20 of max 24
gate: MR(a,b) = Jaccard(N_K(a), N_K(b)) defined and preregistered before use; K = 120 matched mutations with identical seed so differences are attributable to the genotype; shared 64-point domain precondition verified first and could have voided the 58% number.
qualifications: Precondition verified: every D-5 task in F1-F4 uses the identical 64-point domain, otherwise the 58% figure would have been withdrawn; measured on the Gen-1A baseline corpus (5 lineages, I0 only).
substrate: 834 admitted D-5 artifacts (585 in duplicate groups), 120 matched mutations per artifact, 8-task improvement panel
mechanism_hint: behaviour fingerprint vs mutation-neighbourhood sketch; mutational redundancy as Jaccard of offspring fingerprint sets
consumer_hint: repaired the I1 arm definition to require redundancy both behaviourally and mutationally before the Gen-1 freeze

claim_text: Identity-level library composition carries no recoverable policy signature: between-policy terminal-library divergence (Jaccard 0.003-0.045) is indistinguishable from within-policy, different-lineage divergence (0.002-0.005), so the retained library is essentially unique to a run.
source_quote: BETWEEN-POLICY divergence is INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM WITHIN-POLICY divergence. Two libraries built by the same policy on different seeds share as little as two libraries built by different policies. At the level of artifact IDENTITY, the retained library is essentially unique to a run and carries no recoverable policy signature.
verdict_metric: between-arm terminal Jaccard 0.003-0.045; same-arm different-lineage Jaccard 0.002-0.005
qualifications: What does carry a policy signature is the DISTRIBUTION, not the identities: libraries share no artifacts but differ systematically in their statistics; any future claim that a policy produces 'a better library' must be made about distributions, never about which artifacts are in it; candidate-level divergence was not measured (declared instrumentation gap).
substrate: terminal libraries of 4 arms x 30 lineages, Jaccard on artifact identity
mechanism_hint: trajectory component dominates identity-level composition; vindicates the Gen-1A narrowing of the estimand to 'policy + induced trajectory'
consumer_hint: motivates the Memory Transplant follow-on design (section 11, not executed)

claim_text: The mechanism of the Gen-1 retention effect is unresolved: the winning policy moved behavioural diversity exactly as designed (44.1 to 54.8 distinct behaviours) but that property correlates only r=+0.16 with the CFR gain across lineages, so diversity preservation is a confirmed proximate change, not a demonstrated mediator.
source_quote: TRAJECTORY_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED, with a qualification. Identity-level library composition carries NO policy signature at all (section 7), and the one distributional property the winning policy was built to move correlates only r = +0.16 with the gain. What changed capability is not resolved by anything measured here, and the induced search trajectory remains the leading unresolved candidate.
verdict_metric: terminal distinct behaviours I0 44.1 vs I1 54.8; mediation correlation r = +0.16 (I1-I0); library-draw correlate r = -0.70/-0.84 identified as reverse causation and discarded
qualifications: This is NOT the case where library properties were measured and found unchanged - they changed exactly as designed but do not track the outcome across lineages; the strongest correlate (library draws) is an artefact of early termination and is reported as one.
substrate: mechanism autopsy over 30 lineages per arm: distinct behaviours, artifact age, effective uses, draws, credit concentration
mechanism_hint: diversity preservation as proximate change; induced search trajectory as leading unresolved candidate mechanism
consumer_hint: next runner should log first-divergence index and candidate overlap

claim_text: Artifact usefulness has no half-life: the discrete hazard of earning another effective use rises then plateaus (~0.75-0.85 after two uses) rather than decaying, with the only steep transition at the first credit, so empirically forgetting should evict on zero credit after adequate exposure and never on dormancy.
source_quote: THERE IS NO HALF-LIFE. Usefulness does not decay with use; the discrete hazard RISES and then plateaus.
verdict_metric: h(0)=0.556, h(2)=0.753, h(4)=0.825, plateau ~0.8; 44% of 827 artifacts never earn a credit; 24% of used artifacts revive after >= 5 dormant tasks; top 10% of artifacts hold 53% of effective uses
gate: Risk-set hazard estimator; a first version binned by final use count, manufactured a spurious step at j=2, and was corrected before anything was reported (disclosed).
qualifications: Descriptive, from a single-policy observational pass (5 lineages, baseline policy), separate from the Gen-1 analysis set; not a causal claim about what retirement rules would do.
substrate: 827 artifacts, 2,045 timestamped effective-use events, baseline MRU policy, 5 lineages x 42 tasks
mechanism_hint: threshold-then-plateau structure, not exponential decay; dormancy followed by revival
consumer_hint: hazard-based retirement rule recommended for the next generation: evict on zero credit after adequate exposure, never on dormancy

claim_text: The claim in Gen-0 (C4) and the Gen-1A packet that no search-discovered D-5 library was ever persisted was FALSE and is corrected: terminal libraries had been tracked since 2026-08-27; what survives is the narrower claim that the trajectory was never persisted.
source_quote: Gen-0 claim C4 and the Gen-1A packet both asserted that no search-discovered D-5 library was ever persisted. FALSE. agent_d5_blind/developmental_history/ final_libraries/lineage_{0..4}.json have been tracked since 2026-08-27 and hold the actual terminal libraries. I had enumerated ledgers/ and results/ and never looked in developmental_history/ -- a scope claim treated as a measurement.
qualifications: What survives is narrower and still true: the TRAJECTORY was never persisted, which is why the Gen-1A instrument was necessary; separately, a blanket **/results/ gitignore had silently excluded agent_d5_blind/results/ including the pre-committed analysis script a committed verdict cited, fixed with a narrow exception.
substrate: repository state of agent_d5_blind/ (git tracking of developmental_history/final_libraries/)
mechanism_hint: a scope claim treated as a measurement (feedback_prefix_sampling class)

claim_text: Gen-1 was ruled ready to run at n=30 paired lineages but decisively underpowered at the inherited n=5, where the MDE of 10.1pp exceeds the entire 6.7pp content-adaptedness component a retention policy could modulate.
source_quote: VERDICT: GEN1_READY_TO_RUN at n = 30 paired lineages. NOT ready at the inherited n = 5, where the MDE (10.1 pp) exceeds the entire effect a retention policy could modulate (6.7 pp).
verdict_metric: MDE at 80% power: 10.1 pp at n=5, 1.9 pp at n=30 (sigma 0.0412); content-adaptedness component +6.7 pp; full accumulation effect +10.9 pp; lineage variance 1.8% of cell variance; lineage cost 27.2 s
gate: Power analysis simulated the FROZEN one-sided sign-flip permutation test; machinery first reproduced D-5's frozen statistic exactly (+0.1095, n=42, SE 0.0342) before being pointed at anything new; brief hashed at issuance before any analysis.
qualifications: Sigma is estimated from D-5 ablation arms at n=5 lineages so every MDE inherits its uncertainty; the n=5 penalty is mostly sign-flip discreteness (2^5=32 patterns), not heterogeneity; 'lineages are nearly exchangeable' is measured on the headline contrast and not guaranteed for policy contrasts; declared conflict: a GEN1_READY verdict authorises the seat's own expensive run.
substrate: D-5 inherited evidence rows (290 rows, 5 lineages) plus instrumented Gen-1A corpus at 38,000 evaluations/second
mechanism_hint: treatment assigned at the lineage makes the lineage the unit of inference regardless of variance component size
consumer_hint: Gen-1 experiment design (executed as Gen-1B at n=30)

claim_text: The library-persistence instrument is clean: 25 validation checks with 0 failures including 6 constructed gate-fires, 28 unit tests passing, byte-exact same-seed parity, and an adversarial loader battery rejecting 10 of 10 corrupted serializations - confirmed independently by two Ergon instances that built equivalent instruments without contact.
source_quote: TOTAL: 25 checks, 0 failed, 6 of them constructed gate-fires. 28 unit tests, all passing. VERDICT: PERSISTENCE_INSTRUMENT_CLEAN
verdict_metric: 25 checks 0 failed, 6 constructed gate-fires; 28 unit tests passing; gen1a battery: same-seed parity exact, 10/10 adversarial serializations rejected
gate: Every check run twice - once on the real artifact and once on a constructed world where failure is the conclusion known in advance; persistence is observational by construction (frozen m1.py imported unmodified; recorder=None is the only difference between persistence on and off).
qualifications: An instrument report, not a scientific result - nothing here is evidence about memory, retention, or forgetting; parity fixture ran 20 tasks at budget 3000, a determinism claim not a claim about behaviour at the 30k rung (gen1a packet); the duplication between the two instances was accidental, not designed.
substrate: D-5 frozen search core with observational persistence recorder (list-subclass draw observation, thin admission wrapper)
mechanism_hint: observational-by-construction persistence; same-seed parity with rng state hash asserting equal consumption of random values
consumer_hint: precondition for the Gen-1 retention experiment

claim_text: The attainable retention-policy range is nontrivial: replaying the same recorded admission stream through different eviction rules, two policies (LRU_DRAW and EFFUSE) end with terminal libraries sharing not one artifact with the inherited MRU baseline (Jaccard 0.000).
source_quote: Two policies end with libraries sharing NOT ONE artifact with the baseline. The gate does not merely clear, it clears by a wide margin.
verdict_metric: terminal Jaccard vs baseline: RANDOM 0.461, RETIRE_N 0.113, LRU_DRAW 0.000, EFFUSE 0.000; turnover 1.63x the 64-slot cap
gate: Section-5 stop condition 'attainable policy range near zero' - the gate could have returned near-identical libraries and did not (verdict RETENTION_POLICY_RANGE_NONTRIVIAL).
qualifications: All policies share the baseline's admission stream, so divergences are the shared-stream component only and a LOWER BOUND on live divergence; the EFFUSE simulation applies pro-rata baseline credit and is a proxy for arm divergence, not an estimate of arm performance.
substrate: replay of 170 admitted artifacts/lineage and 105 evictions/lineage through five eviction rules on the Gen-1A instrumented corpus
mechanism_hint: eviction-rule replay over a fixed admission stream
consumer_hint: cleared the Gen-1 stop condition before the policy experiment ran

claim_text: The D-5 consumer's appetite is for content, not abstractions: its library slot eats whole executable genotypes as mutation seeds with no application, splice, or primitive-extension site, so Family A's characteristic product (a reusable parameterised abstraction becoming a new primitive) has no slot at any acquisition price.
source_quote: The D-5 library slot eats whole executable genotypes used as mutation seeds. It has no application site, no splice site, and no primitive-extension path. So the characteristic product of Family A -- a reusable parameterised abstraction that becomes a new primitive -- has nowhere to go AT ANY ACQUISITION PRICE. No primary arm ran. Two independent gates stopped it, and the brief names both as valid results.
verdict_metric: 14 frozen opcodes, zero registration hooks; consumer-fit probe gate-fired 7/7 constructed worlds with known answers
gate: Every verdict issues from one gate-fired classify() function; worlds W1 and W2 force the probe to say CONSUMABLE about a native artifact and a Stitch-shaped zero-hole motif, so a probe merely biased toward NOT_CONSUMABLE would fail.
qualifications: Scope is ONE consumer - 'no slot in D-5' is not 'useless to Prometheus'; Family A is currently UNADJUDICABLE rather than refuted because no consumer in the programme has a primitive-extension path; the hole-marker model of a Stitch abstraction is the weakest joint (F2, straw-donor risk); freeze-order breach self-reported (F6).
substrate: frozen source of agent_d5_blind (learner/m1.py, mutation/physics.py, substrate/rm_vm.py) read by execution of consumer_fit.py
mechanism_hint: consumer interface contract: consumption path is mutate(extra_pool[draw]) and nothing else
consumer_hint: gates the Family A/B donor decision; motivates 'persist the libraries, then vary the admission rule' as the next experiment
related_hints: Lexis G1 fired kill on 'forge more tools' (roles/Lexis/ROLE.md section 5)

claim_text: Family B (equality-saturation rewriting) requires a new synthesis layer for this consumer: egglog alone can supply at best behaviourally redundant seeds to a slot that already dedupes on behaviour fingerprints, a predictably null contribution.
source_quote: THE DEEPER BLOCKER, WHICH COVERAGE DOES NOT FIX. Equality saturation returns terms EQUIVALENT to its input. Equivalent genotypes compute the same function. D-5's admission is already behaviour-distinct de-duplicated on output fingerprints. So egglog alone can supply, at best, behaviourally redundant seeds to a slot that already dedupes on behaviour -- measurable in principle, and predictably null. That is not the Family-B hypothesis.
verdict_metric: 68.0% (53/78) of solution witnesses are jump-free/equationally expressible; control flow concentrates (CTRL 0/10, F3 3/10 vs F1/F4 12/12)
gate: Lexis G3 pre-commits to stating the attainable range of the readout FIRST, so the census preceded any design; preregistered kill for the successor build: shortest-equivalent seeds must change per-task CFR against a length-matched random-genotype control at identical metered budget or Family B is dead for this consumer.
qualifications: Section verdict FAMILY_B_REQUIRES_NEW_SYNTHESIS_LAYER; the 68% census is measured on oracle witnesses declared inadmissible as library seeds (F5) - if the census is ruled privileged the number falls but the verdict survives on the encoding argument alone; a rewriter restricted to the jump-free fragment would be systematically blind to specific families, not uniformly weaker.
substrate: 78 known D-5 solution witnesses; egglog 13.2.0 measured at run time and verified against Techne's pin
mechanism_hint: behavioural-equivalence redundancy vs a behaviour-deduping admission rule; length is the only rewrite product that can move the D-5 readout (reachability)
consumer_hint: smallest next Family-B capability specified: equational theory of the jump-free RM-D5 fragment emitting shortest equivalent genotypes

claim_text: Under the frozen D-5 policy the library is a rolling recency window of roughly the last 16 tasks, not an accumulation over 58: memory depth is 16-18 tasks across all five lineages and 69-72% of developmental history is absent at the endpoint.
source_quote: Under the frozen policy the library is a ROLLING RECENCY WINDOW over roughly the last 16 tasks. It is not an accumulation over 58.
verdict_metric: memory depth 16, 18, 16, 16, 17 tasks (mean 16.6 of 58); history absent at endpoint 69-72% (mean 71%); 64 slots / 4.03 admissions per task = 15.9 tasks
qualifications: D-5 flagged this qualitatively ('design task ecologies where library content cannot saturate'); this is a refinement of a known limitation, not a new discovery; consequences C1 (G7 measured transfer from a 16-task window) and C2 (shuffled-history ordering conclusion bounded to ~16 tasks) are disclosed for Charon/Aporia adjudication, not asserted as reinterpretations.
substrate: persisted trajectories of 5 D-5 lineages (admission positions of every terminal-library artifact)
mechanism_hint: recency-forgetting: Gen-1's real contrast is RECENCY-forgetting versus SELECTIVE-forgetting, not accumulation versus forgetting
consumer_hint: raises Q8/Q11: whether the cap and task count should be re-chosen so the library spans a meaningful fraction of the lineage

claim_text: The D-5 search core is verified frozen by execution: replay reproduced all 290 committed evidence rows and all 5 committed terminal libraries byte-exact, comparators authored by a different agent weeks earlier.
source_quote: A reviewer should note what this buys: the D-5 search core is verified frozen BY EXECUTION, which is a stronger guarantee than the hash list that was supposed to provide it (section 8).
verdict_metric: 290/290 evidence rows reproduced; 5/5 terminal libraries byte-exact in order (320 ordered genotypes / 5,425 instructions); 80 solved rows matched first_solve as an exact integer, range 9..29820
gate: Check E is not self-graded: its comparators were written by a different agent weeks earlier and cannot be tuned by this seat.
qualifications: 210 of 290 rows are unsolved and agreement on those is nearly free; the informative parts are the 80 solved rows and the terminal libraries, which match only if every mutation draw, crossover cut, admission and eviction decision agreed across 58 tasks x 30,000 evaluations x 5 lineages.
substrate: replay of agent_d5_blind M1 lineages against committed m1_rows.jsonl and final_libraries/
mechanism_hint: verification by execution rather than by hash list; one divergent draw anywhere would propagate and destroy the match
consumer_hint: establishes the substrate Gen-1 builds on is actually frozen

claim_text: The claim that D-5's pre-committed analysis script (results/compute_gates.py) was lost and the +10.95pp headline therefore unreproducible is WITHDRAWN: the directory was gitignore-excluded, not lost, and both compute_gates.py and gates_verdict.json now match their frozen hashes.
source_quote: An earlier draft of this packet claimed that results/compute_gates.py -- the pre-committed hashed script VERDICT.md attributes all analysis to -- was LOST, and therefore that +10.95pp could be re-derived but never reproduced. THAT CLAIM IS WITHDRAWN. It was wrong.
verdict_metric: freeze record now covers 33 entries with none absent; compute_gates.py and gates_verdict.json both match hashes recorded before any M1 row was read
qualifications: 'Absent from my checkout with no git history' is equally consistent with gitignore exclusion, which is what happened (blanket **/results/); a discovery-path failure is not a fact about the world; what survives from the original finding is 8.1-8.3 (nothing reads the freeze record; byte-level check reports 17 false CRLF violations on Windows; one genuine post-freeze edit).
substrate: git history and .gitignore state of agent_d5_blind/results/
mechanism_hint: instrument error is not evidence; two hypotheses the evidence did not separate, with the more dramatic one reported

claim_text: Exactly one genuine post-freeze edit exists in D-5's freeze record after line-ending normalization: the anti-cheat script itself, changed in the same commit that reported the +10.95pp headline to exempt run_arm.py from its own oracle-field scan - graded MEDIUM because any residual oracle access would strengthen the comparator and shrink, not inflate, the headline.
source_quote: This is the defect class this campaign is named for, arriving in someone else's codebase: **a check that removes a region before inspecting it.** It is why I looked.
verdict_metric: 18 of 31 freeze entries fail byte-level check; 17 explained by core.autocrlf CRLF rewriting (false violations); 1 genuine mismatch (anti_cheat/static_checks.py, frozen at 1c68630da, edited in b503c5cfd)
qualifications: Assessment largely exculpatory: the exemption is documented, its stated mitigation (m0.py/m1.py remain scanned) holds under inspection, and the anti-cheat battery passes today; the direction is conservative - residual oracle access would strengthen M0 the comparator and shrink the M1 advantage; severity MEDIUM, a reproducibility gap not a validity finding; filed for Charon and Aporia, not self-adjudicated.
substrate: agent_d5_blind/anti_cheat/frozen_hashes.json (31 files, five freeze points) checked by verify_d5_freeze.py with LF normalization
mechanism_hint: a check that removes a region before inspecting it; byte-level freeze checks are inoperative on Windows checkouts and should hash line-ending-normalized content
consumer_hint: Charon (with the Gen-1 attack packet, attack F12)

claim_text: A one-line non-LLM heuristic (count of the five integers coprime to 30) scores 0.5225 on fresh unseen tasks while the free-host solver scores 0.4794, so the probe band's attainable-without-reasoning floor is ~0.52, not the 0.25 chance floor the [0.35, 0.60] band was reasoned against.
source_quote: "Count how many of the five numbers are not divisible by 2, 3, or 5" scores 0.5225 on unseen tasks. The solver scores 0.4794.** A one-line arithmetic filter, with no primality reasoning of any kind, beats the model by ~4pp — and it generalizes, so it is not a lookup table memorizing this manifest.
verdict_metric: coprime-to-30 heuristic CV 0.5700, fresh-seed 0.5225; solver 0.4794; chance 0.2500; sized confound ~+4pp, half the +8pp the probe is powered for
gate: Scored by lookup table with cross-validation and re-scored on 400 fresh tasks from the same generator at a different seed; method census cleared against a permutation null (CV 0.2900 vs null 95th percentile 0.2950).
qualifications: If neither proposed repair is adopted, any Delta_carry from this family must be reported with the heuristic floor stamped beside it, and a positive result cannot distinguish metabolization from method-priming; the F-generic control arm is itself confounded by envelope shape (separable by shape alone, no classifier required).
substrate: pinned nearmiss_mix-M30 manifest, non-LLM controls via task_controls.py, $0 and no API calls
mechanism_hint: method-priming confound: residue that merely reminds the solver to filter small factors could move accuracy from 0.48 toward 0.52 with zero metabolization
consumer_hint: Charon (kill authority) to rule on F-generic envelope repair and an F-method-hint arm

claim_text: The +14pp free-vs-paid host delta cited in the probe preregistration was an artifact and is withdrawn: it compared a settled paid read against an n=40 free read whose own verdict was UNDECIDED; campaign data (n=395) reads the real delta at approximately +6pp.
source_quote: The **"+14pp host delta"** I cited in the prereg earlier today was an artifact and I have withdrawn it. It compared a settled paid read (M20, n=200, 0.640) against a free read of **n=40 whose own verdict was `UNDECIDED`, interval [0.303, 0.697]**. Campaign data (n=395) reads 0.5772 against paid 0.640 → real delta **≈+6pp**, and against the earlier truncation-corrected estimate ≈+1.6pp.
verdict_metric: withdrawn +14pp; corrected ~+6pp (free 0.5772 n=395 vs paid 0.640 n=200); at M30 the host delta is ~0
gate: The no-pooling rule between hosts stands unchanged but on principle (different host, different served model version, R9 pinning), not on the withdrawn measurement.
qualifications: Corrected in the prereg and in memory the same day; an instance of quoting a statistic measured on one population as a property of another (wrong-population statistics).
substrate: free-host vs paid-host solver reads on M20/M30 rungs of the nearmiss task ladder
mechanism_hint: comparing a settled read against an undecided n=40 interval
consumer_hint: Charon ruling on band-escalation route

claim_text: The first P1 band-read attempt was quarantined whole as TRUNCATION-CONFOUNDED: 3.13% of rep-1 calls hit the 8192-token cap, truncated rows scored 0.000 while parse-fail read 0.000, and the defect dragged the point estimate downward into the band - flattering the gate.
source_quote: the first P1 attempt was **quarantined whole** as `TRUNCATION-CONFOUNDED` (3.13% of rep-1 calls hit the 8192-token cap; truncated rows scored 0.000 while parse-fail read 0.000, because the frozen extractor lifts arithmetic scratch numbers out of mid-reasoning trial division). The truncation was dragging the point estimate **downward, into** the band — i.e. **the defect was flattering the gate**.
verdict_metric: 3.13% truncation at 8192-token cap; cap raised to 16384; current truncation 0.0000
qualifications: Always ask which direction a confound pushes relative to the gate: this one flattered it (feedback_truncation_can_flatter_a_gate).
substrate: P1 band-read of the free-host solver on the nearmiss manifest, frozen answer extractor
mechanism_hint: truncated responses parsed to mid-reasoning scratch numbers, scoring 0.000 without registering as parse failures

claim_text: Failed API calls were being loaded as prior-attempt residue (DEFECT CONFIRMED): the prepass loader admits http_error rows, and in block B, at a 24.4% transport error rate, 43 of 220 tasks had no ok prepass row yet rendered F-prom packets asserting a prior attempt - fabricated residue byte-indistinguishable from the legitimate empty-vocabulary case.
source_quote: **Status** DEFECT CONFIRMED, unpatched by design — the fix changes a pinned population and is filed for the kill authority.
verdict_metric: block A 15/415 http_error (3.6%), zero pure-fabrication tasks, no collected arm data invalidated; block B 60/246 http_error (24.4%), 43/220 tasks with no ok prepass row
gate: Unpatched by design - the fix changes a pinned population and is filed for the kill authority; found by following Harmonia B's HB3 scope condition requiring packet_invariants to re-run against block B before its rows are read.
qualifications: Block A content intact (treatment method census unchanged; the 38 shifted packets are the sparsity block, all six arms); block B actively fabricating; ATK-013's rule in a new location - a lookup that finds zero usable rows must refuse, never return a renderable value.
substrate: ergon/probe/assemble.load_prepass over block A (pinned e6b1e001) and block B (7444a178) prepass ledgers
mechanism_hint: status filter excludes only 'scrap', admitting transport failures as residue records
consumer_hint: Charon (kill authority) rules on the population fix

claim_text: The R13-POWER-FLOOR-UNMET halt is resolved: executing the preregistered block-B merge rule gives block A 0.4742 (n=194) and block B 0.4597 (n=211), both LEVELED with overlapping intervals, so pooling is permitted and the pooled n=405 meets the R13 floor of 300.
source_quote: `R13-POWER-FLOOR-UNMET` was the standing HALT of 2026-08-25 (n_post 194 < 300). It is now met, by the merge rule executed as preregistered in `PREREG_block_B_merge_rule_2026-08-25.md` §3 and implemented in `ergon/probe/blocks.py::merge_reading`.
gate: Merge rule executed as preregistered (PREREG_block_B_merge_rule_2026-08-25.md section 3); reported block-wise, never pooled alone; block B's cross-family screen was defined (440/440 coverage, transport_ok_rate 1.0000) as the rule requires.
qualifications: Standing caveats travel with these numbers: the screen is SCREEN-LENIENT (it failed to find contamination, it does not exclude it); the read is D0 self-generated first-cycle residue and says nothing about the native D2/D3 corpus; the heuristic floor still stands (coprime-to-30 0.5225 vs solver 0.4900) - more power under an unbeaten heuristic floor is more power, not a result; P2 collection remained BLOCKED on a Charon ruling over the single-block residue pool.
substrate: campaign blocks A and B, cross-family Tier B reads on the nearmiss manifests
mechanism_hint: block-wise collection with pooling at the statistic; the ATK-013 guard (raise on missing prepass) stopped the run before fabricating residue on a defect its author did not anticipate
consumer_hint: unblocks the P2 factorial pending the Charon pool-scoping ruling

claim_text: Cold-start feature routing is NULL: a held-out scrap's concept/field metadata carries no routing signal over popularity (FEATURE AUC 0.744 vs POP 0.753, and real fields perform the same as shuffled fields), so a tool cannot be routed to problems from its concept labels.

claim_text: The greedy-LoRA +0.68 gain decomposes into format-following, a False/kill prior, and narrow per-source template classes with no cross-domain transfer and almost no genuine reasoning - a calibrating kill establishing that more failure data of the same shape will not grow the reasoning share.
source_quote: The greedy LoRA's gain decomposes, in order of size, into: **format-following ≫ a False/kill prior ≫ narrow per-source template-classes ≫ genuine reasoning**. There is **no cross-domain transfer** — not across substrate sources, and not even across sub-domains of the same meta-domain (number theory). The "needle moved +0.68" headline is real but is almost entirely format + prior + per-template memorization. This is a calibrating kill: **adding more failure data of the same shape will not grow the reasoning share.**
verdict_metric: leave-one-out: drop theseus 0.86->0.25, drop hephaestus 1.0->0.29, drop pollux 1.0->0.395 with other slices untouched; computable-gold OOD judgement 0.55 vs 0.50 chance with T/F split 0.20/0.90 (False prior); diverse-gold transfer +0.027 on n=600, ~1.3 sigma, NOT significant
gate: OOD set built with deterministically computed gold (494 balanced number-theory claims, domains disjoint from training) rather than a circular LLM judge; headline first reproduced exactly (base 0.228 -> full 0.908) before ablation.
qualifications: All of the above is about the gold-judgement metric; the Learner's actual objective (routing by failure) had no eval yet; pure failure-reasoning sources have no gold slice of their own so only their transfer (nil) is measured; transfer appears only where the surface pattern is shared and is absent exactly where genuine computation is required.
substrate: Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct rank-16 LoRA on greedy substrate scrape, 1,200-item gold set plus 494-claim computable-gold OOD set
mechanism_hint: surface classifiers, not computation: format + prior + per-template memorization
consumer_hint: redirected the Learner toward a routing eval instead of more surface-metric LoRA runs

claim_text: The object_zeros NULL defect was root-caused: the 2026-04-16 load assigned object_id only to the 24,922 curves already in the registry because the registry's id sequence was desynced and would have collided on the primary key, leaving 1,984,167 of 2,009,089 elliptic-curve rows with NULL object_id; the repair is reversible above watermark 134475.
source_quote: The 2026-04-16 load only assigned `object_id` to the 24,922 curves already present in `xref.object_registry`. The registry's id sequence (`xref.object_registry_object_id_seq`) was **desynced** — `last_value=1, is_called=false` while `max(object_id)=134475` — so any insert using the sequence default would have collided on the primary key. The loader therefore left the remaining ~1.98M curves with NULL `object_id`.
verdict_metric: 1,984,167 / 2,009,089 rows NULL; sequence last_value=1 vs max(object_id)=134475; reversibility watermark 134475
qualifications: lmfdb_label (the true identity) is intact on every row; arrays/labels are clean; the same NULL pattern exists in the *_corrupt_20260416 quarantine copies; repair is fully reversible (every touched row gets object_id > 134475).
substrate: prometheus_fire Postgres database, zeros.object_zeros and xref.object_registry
mechanism_hint: desynced id sequence causing the loader to skip registration; batched register-and-backfill repair driven by a scheduled task
